period.label: Period
period.toAfterFrom: Pick a date on or after the start

columns.title: Columns
columns.full: The table is full. Turn one column off to add another.

equation.sentence: Net sales {net} minus purchase cost {cost} minus commission {commission} equals profit after commission {profit}.
equation.netSub: {deals, plural, one {# deal} other {# deals}} · {units} units

paid.title: Counted when paid in full.
paid.text: A deal counts on the day the customer's last payment arrives, not when the order is made or delivered.

net.title: Net sales
net.text: are the order totals without VAT.

cost.title: Purchase cost
cost.text: is units × landed unit cost (goods, freight and excise), fixed on the day the deal was paid.

commission.title: Commission
commission.text: is what the agent earns on the deal; special prices are paid out of it.

credit.title: Credit notes
credit.text: reduce net sales, purchase cost and commission in the period they are issued.

once.title: Each deal counts once.
once.text: The same figure appears on Home, here and in Monthly P&L.

empty.dealsTitle: No paid deals in this period
empty.dealsText: Deals appear here on the day the customer pays in full. Try a longer period.
empty.pnlText: Pick a period that has already started to see sales, expenses and profit per month.

bank.title: Record bank balance
bank.sub: Use the balance shown in online banking at the end of the day.
bank.accountHelp: Add your accounts in Settings › Bank details to pick them from a list.
bank.stale: The bank balance is {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old
bank.missingSub: Record it once a week so cash on hand stays right.
